motion: The camera does not move. Heavy rain falls across the night high street. The green and cream double-decker bus pulls away from the stop and drives steadily away from us down the long wet road, getting smaller, its lit top deck and red tail lights shrinking into the rain. Its reflections trail on the wet tarmac. The two people in hooded coats walk slowly along the pavement on the right. The shop signs and the shopfronts stay exactly as they are; the closed whitewashed bank beside the pharmacy stays dark and closed. The camera does not move.
